gen-fs-quilon-gf-gafata: Commanding, Quilon sets the tone with lightly engraved, brass-like strokes. Gafata backs it up with a wide-eyed lowercase e and short stalks, keeping the text low in contrast so the heading's engraved feel stays the main event.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-geist: Quilon's stroke thickness rises and falls slowly, giving its editorial headings a commanding pull. And Geist, with its level beat and solid word shapes, has no trouble being set modestly small.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-georama: Georama reads friendly, its c parted like a bracelet pulled apart and its capitals barely rising. But if Quilon is made small, its medium-contrast strokes lose their editorial punch.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-golos-text: Crisp and commanding: Quilon's hairline-thinned curves give headings an editorial edge. And Golos Text, with uniform strokes and an x-height that fills the line, should carry page after page without tiring the eye.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-heebo: Quilon is built for presence, with a gentle shift in stroke weight and an editorial, commanding air. Heebo is built for text, its low-contrast curves stopping short of closing in.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-hind-guntur: Quilon's stroke weight rises and falls with quiet editorial confidence, its medium-low contrast giving display lettering real authority. Let Hind Guntur stay modest in size; its stamped-metal lowercase carries itself.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-karla: Karla reads stocky and friendly, with a gaping c. Quilon's heavier verticals and lighter horizontals add editorial polish up top, while the sans below keeps paragraphs moving with a relaxed, modern rhythm.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-khula: Quilon arrives editorial and commanding, with fuller stems and slimmer links. Khula's open-mouthed curves and squat brush-pen belly make it a quiet partner, which lets Quilon's cadence take the lead.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-lexend-exa: Quilon's gentle stroke modulation is its signature, giving editorial headings a commanding but comfortable pull. Lexend Exa does the opposite work, with uniform line thickness, stubby ascenders and open curves that stay distinct.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-lexend-giga: Quilon gives headings an editorial, commanding look, its weight shifting gently where bowls curve. Lexend Giga keeps flat, single-weight lines and generous tracking, letting each word breathe through extended reading.
